pkgmetadata.longdescription: Standalone Linux desktop integration for the Logitech MX Master 4: a dependency-light raw-hidraw HID++ 2.0 daemon (mx4d) that fires the mouse's native haptic motor and captures the haptic Actions Ring touch panel as a software trigger, a Qt6/QML radial menu overlay (mx4-radial) and a settings GUI (mx4-config). Init-agnostic (systemd OR OpenRC/runit/s6 via a portable XDG autostart entry) and DE-aware (the KWin focus-bridge is shipped as inert data, Plasma-Wayland only).

use.flag: Pull in PulseAudio (pactl) or PipeWire (pw-mon) so the opt-in system-sound haptic source has a monitor to read; without it that one ambient source is simply disabled.
Install the systemd user units (mx4desktop.service, mx4-overlay.service). With this flag off the portable XDG autostart entry handles login startup on any init.
